descriptor_scope: base semantic-carrier contract; not a registered runtime implementation

I.name: Input
I.meaning: Objects, data, systems, populations or other task inputs and in-scope subjects.

O.name: Output
O.meaning: Declared deliverables or externally observable results.

A.name: Actions
A.meaning: Required, permitted or otherwise task-relevant operations, preserving actor, effect, target and modality where known.

P.name: Participants
P.meaning: Humans, Agents, systems and services participating in execution, approval, observation, review, receipt or collaboration.

R.name: Resources
R.meaning: Quantitative limits, budgets, capacities, deadlines, durations and thresholds.

V.name: Version / Provenance
V.meaning: Controlling versions, policies, evidence sources and temporal baselines.

C.name: Completion
C.meaning: Completion, stop, acceptance and escalation conditions.

B.name: Forbidden Boundary
B.meaning: Prohibited effects, targets, actions or combinations, including guards and exceptions.
